selection_policy: Current primary Mastra documentation, official Mastra engineering announcements, official Mastra repository/release metadata, and current Aurora accepted Blueprints. The goal is architecture fit and ownership boundaries, not a feature-count comparison.

sources.title: @mastra/core 1.56.0 release
limitations: Rapid release cadence means exact APIs must be pinned and revalidated before implementation

sources.title: Mastra repository license
supports: Apache-2.0 licensing for repository content outside ee directories
limitations: Individual dependencies retain their own licenses

sources.title: Mastra Enterprise Edition license
supports: production restrictions for ee directory code without written agreement
limitations: Does not enumerate every platform/commercial service term

sources.title: Build Claude Code for X with Agent Controller
supports: sessions, modes, permissions, subagents, persisted state and UI events
limitations: Interactive control state is provider-local state, not Aurora global state

sources.title: Announcing Observational Memory
supports: Mastra positioning OM as primary memory direction
limitations: Observational synthesis remains probabilistic and cannot own authoritative Aurora state

sources.title: Observational Memory research
limitations: Conversation-memory benchmark results do not prove project/authority correctness

sources.title: Introducing Memory Extractors for Mastra Agents
limitations: Extracted values are model-derived candidates and require Aurora provenance/governance before promotion

sources.title: Introducing Workspaces
supports: filesystem, command execution, search and skills capabilities
limitations: Workspace permissions are local containment; LocalSandbox is not equivalent to an OS security boundary

sources.title: Mastra Agent Harness template
supports: workspace, tool approval, memory, scheduling and local storage integration
limitations: Template explicitly warns LocalSandbox does not provide operating-system isolation by default

sources.title: Introducing Background Tasks for Mastra Agents
limitations: Background-task persistence is local execution state, not global mission authority

sources.title: Introducing Durable Agents
limitations: Durable stream/run state does not replace Aurora canonical mission/delegation state

sources.title: Mastra Workflow snapshots
limitations: Workflow snapshots are engine execution state and must remain below Aurora operational truth

sources.title: Mastra Workflows Enhanced / Temporal
limitations: Temporal adds operational/history complexity and is not justified by M0 requirements

sources.title: Announcing Agent Signals
limitations: Developer-defined attributes and signals are context inputs, not authentication or authority

sources.title: Introducing Schedules for Mastra Agents and Workflows
limitations: Schedule existence does not imply Aurora authorization to run the scheduled effect

sources.title: Introducing Goals for Mastra Agents
limitations: LLM goal judges cannot become Aurora acceptance authority

sources.title: Introducing Tool Hooks for Mastra Agents
limitations: Hooks are an integration/enforcement point; the authoritative policy decision must remain outside probabilistic agent state

sources.title: Agent-to-Agent support for Mastra
limitations: A2A transport does not define Aurora delegation authority or global acceptance

sources.title: Agent Client Protocol support for Mastra Agents
supports: delegation to Claude Agent, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and ACP harnesses
limitations: Harness delegation through ACP must still obey Aurora child-delegation and authority boundaries

sources.title: Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex agents in Mastra
limitations: Provider/harness-native permissions remain distinct from Aurora authority

sources.title: Mastra RAG Pipeline
supports: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval, reranking, agentic/Graph RAG
limitations: Retrieval relevance does not establish source authority or freshness by itself

sources.title: Mastra Composite Storage
limitations: Switching backends still requires data migration and does not make Mastra storage Aurora canonical state

sources.title: Mastra Server Adapters
limitations: Mastra HTTP API is a provider binding; Aurora should own its external contract semantics

sources.title: Announcing Mastra Observability
limitations: Platform observability is optional external infrastructure and cannot own Aurora evidence or canonical state

sources.title: Gates and Verdicts for Mastra Evals
limitations: Mastra eval verdicts are evidence inputs and cannot automatically close Aurora acceptance criteria

sources.title: Announcing Mastra Factory
supports: typed workflows, memory, scheduling, tools and observability
limitations: Factory is an example/composition substrate, not Aurora global product authority
